name: India
intro: Unlock a land of profound heritage, architectural marvels, and cooperative community enterprise. From the historical lanes of Old Delhi to the backwater lagoons of Kerala, India is a majestic cultural epic.
bestSeason: October to March (Cool and dry season across most regions)
weather: Varies by region. Tropical monsoon in the south, seasonal subtropical in the north. Comfortable dry winter months (12°C to 26°C) are ideal for sightseeing.
language: Hindi, English, regional languages (Marathi, Malayalam, Rajasthani)
visaInfo: Indian tourist e-Visa required for international passport holders prior to arrival.
flightDuration: Domestic travel or short direct flights between hubs.
highlights: Witness the industrial drive and sorting systems in Mumbai Dharavi
Gaze at the Taj Mahal dome reflecting the morning sunrise in Agra
Cruise the quiet palm-fringed backwaters of Kerala on a solar houseboat
Sleep in community-run heritage Haveli hotels in Old Delhi and Jaipur
